content: Go CLI best practices: keep main() thin — just parse flags, call business logic, handle top-level errors. Put testable logic in internal packages with pure functions. Separate string production from printing (return string, let main print) to enable table-driven tests without stdout capture. Use go:embed for static assets bundled into binary. Cross-platform concerns handled at OS level not with build tags when possible. go test ./... is standard test invocation. go build -o binname . for local build.
